discovery: Discovery of geometric phases in quantum mechanics (the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the Berry phase)
rationale: Recent prizes went to applied and quantum-technology work (attosecond pulses in 2023, machine learning in 2024, superconducting circuits in 2025). Foundational theory is overdue for recognition. Geometric phases underpin topological matter, quantum computing and modern band theory. Both laureates are long-standing favourites, and both are elderly, which adds urgency.
